name: Epsom
_about: Written by tools/course/epsom/to_race_view.py from courses/epsom-draft.json; don't edit by hand. World axes as York's: x along the home straight (the horses run towards -x), y up, the winning post on the inside rail is the origin. LEFT-handed (hand -1): the inside rail z 0 on the horses' left, the track to z = -trackWidth on their right, the stands beyond (z < -trackWidth), the infield (the Hill) +z. Several routes (each race takes its start's route), each with its own ground heights for the race engine; the turf is laid on the ground grid.
axes: As York: origin = winning post on the inside rail; y up. On the home straight the horses run towards -x. LEFT-handed: the inside rail (z = 0) is on the horses' left, the track runs to z = -trackWidth on their right; on the home straight the stands are beyond (z < -trackWidth, north) and the infield (the Hill) is +z.
